description: This header file defines the exported API functions for an HTTP tokenizer component, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions, primarily used in a Cross-Layer Service Platform environment.

methods.name: AnscCreateHttpTokenizerComponent
methods.description: Creates and initializes an HTTP tokenizer component instance.

methods.name: AnscHttpTokenizerCOCreate
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP tokenizer control object.

methods.name: AnscHttpTokenizerCORemove
methods.description: Removes a specific HTTP tokenizer control object.

methods.name: AnscHttpTokenizerCOEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the HTTP tokenizer control object.

methods.name: AnscHttpTokenizerCOInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP tokenizer control object.
